What are the Course Objectives? The objectives of this Microsoft Azure certification course are given below Understanding the advantages of using Source Control for several developers working on the same platform. Swift Migration from TFVC(version control tool) to Git. Developing and implementing security tactics for the applications developed. Managing and implementing build infrastructure. Managing the configurations for applications. Implementing the DevOps strategy for mobile-based applications. 2. Who Should Attend DevOps – AZ 400 Certification? Anyone who is a Microsoft Administrator or Developer certified professional can plan to pursue this course. Any individual who has prior experience working with MS Azure cloud can enroll in this course to become a certified DevOps Engineer. Any individual with some Agile methodology or IT development cycle experience can also plan to enroll themselves for better career prospects. However, such an individual needs to put extra effort to understand the basic concepts relevant to cloud technology. 3. Pre-requisites for Microsoft Azure Administrator – DevOps AZ 400 Certification It would help if you had either of the following before you can pursue Microsoft DevOps Certification. Microsoft Certified Azure Administrator OR Microsoft Certified Azure Developer 4. What you will learn in this certification course? Understanding the architecture for MS Azure cloud services Analyzing the resources and infrastructure offered by MS Azure. Learning about how to make the sites reliable and improving response to incidents in MS Azure. Monitoring the health of Azure Load balancer and VM’s Controlling and monitoring security measures to be implemented using MS Azure cloud. Migrating and managing existing repository to Git hub. Understanding of strategies to implement for continuous planning and integration through the use of Azure pipelines. Managing costs involved in using MS Azure cloud service. Designing a strategy for the Release process and Managing workflow. Selecting the best deployment process and implementing a system that will route the feedback to developers. Creating and managing Kubernetes services offered by Azure. Different code tools that are available with Azure. Hands-on projects for application-based understanding. 5. How long will it take to complete Microsoft Azure Administrator – DevOps – AZ – 400 Certification? This program’s duration is 30-50 hours, depending on prior experience and passion for learning. 6. What are the job roles offered after completion of Microsoft Azure Administrator – DevOps – AZ 400 Certifications? Industry-recognized Microsoft Azure Administrator – DevOps –AZ 400 certifications opens the door to working as a DevOps Engineer. It is a challenging task but with better salary packages and better career development prospects.
